scoringPolicy: Exact accepted most-specific rank and canonical ID, or exact unresolved/nonbiological state. No automatic ancestor credit. Holds have reference=null and are excluded before any future freeze, never replaced after results.
exposure: All 20 are exposed development observations; no remaining old-heldout pixels reviewed.

cases.visible: Elongated pale cap with hanging scales and darker crown; pale stalk visible.
cases.limitation: Mapping remains unverified in both screen arms; do not infer the unknown name.
cases.rationale: Retain the prior assistant-reviewed rank, with the exact-image observation and limitation from the audit; no new independent biological validation.

cases.visible: Damaged or dissected pale chambered fruiting bodies and dark internal material; mature pitted cap surface not clearly exposed.
cases.limitation: Shared reference wording asserts a diagnostic mature head not established by these pixels.
cases.rationale: The damaged/dissected material does not securely establish a differentiated mature head. Species is unsupported; exclusive genus/family and appropriate unresolved disposition remain uncertain.

cases.visible: White chambered stalk; dark slimy head with flies obscuring much of its surface.
cases.limitation: Cannot confidently distinguish reticulate relief from slime texture; species regression claim needs reference adjudication.
cases.rationale: A structurally differentiated simple slimy head above a pale chambered stalk supports Phallus; the obscured head surface does not settle species.
